$Comment: Throwing a Rare Lantern Bomb, in the game's own order: the throw animation, a one-second cooldown, the bomb leaves the hand (Hallows_Eve_Lantern_Bomb_Rare_Projectile), the throw counts as USE_ITEM with the Qualifier Throw, and only then is one bomb taken from the hand. Spending the bomb last is what lets the last bomb of a stack finish its own throw. A step counting thrown bombs names Target Hallows_Eve_Lantern_Bomb_Rare, or the prefix Hallows_Eve_Lantern_Bomb_ for every tier.
